baseline: Reuse the sealed fitted finite scene in sonar-partial-scene-fit-20261031. Original native data and fixed navigation means remain shared by hash; no raw copies. Reference geometry/truth/RGB cannot enter discovery or selection.
proposal_image: Compute the same source ensemble mean over the full original 599x256 range/beam grid using linear Hamming autocorrelation, source-range Fourier lags and the original-N FFT; source ray normals and beam mixing unchanged. Retain signed cancellation values and a diagnostic arithmetic envelope of 512*float64_epsilon*N*beam_mixed_source_power. This is not sensor noise or calibrated confidence. Check selected native means against the existing exact operator. Never replace original powers.
regions: Identical 5x5 local positive power averages for original data and prediction. One full-image total-power gain. Candidate excess when observed average exceeds four times gain-scaled predicted mean plus arithmetic envelope. Four-connected components, at least 8 pixels and 3 beams. Preserve all labels/components, including rejected ones. Top eight by excess-power mass per training view enter the bounded birth search; all others remain unknown. These are proposal settings, not a calibrated false-alarm rate.
multiview_support: Every selected region pixel in the physical .2..15m range contributes its entire +/-10deg elevation fan, 65 nominal elevation samples, .2m world search cells at the supplied navigation mean. Keep all per-view/region memberships. Require at least three distinct training views for a proposal; duplicate pixels/regions in one view never add view count. Sampling/cell size does not certify continuous support or physical correspondence.
birth_modes: Rank shared cells by distinct views, then sum of mean excess per region divided by the frame common gain, then lexicographic cell. Consider cells .075..1.5m above the same causal-DVL-mean seed plane; this is a ground-supported shape hypothesis, not measured terrain. Preserve all ineligible/skipped cells. Skip XY inside either existing prism bounding box expanded by .2m. Greedy .75m XY separation, at most three modes. For each use a .4x.4m axis-aligned ground-supported finite box with top at cell-centre z plus [-.1,0,.1]m, clamped to .05..1.5m height. Uniform reflectivity .001. Retain unchanged scene and an explicit alternative removing the prior single-view-only reflector's faces; deletion means transparent absence, not opaque zero reflectivity.
queries: Freeze per training view before fitting: 32 controls at native ranges [60,180,360,540] x eight beam indices rounded uniformly from16 to239; union with up to four actual member pixels per selected region at sorted-list quantiles [0,1/3,2/3,1]. At most64 pixels. All alternatives use the same original queries and profiled common gain. Selection uses training composite mean score only, without independence or confidence claims. No continuous height refinement or search-budget extension.
unused_queries: After construction is sealed, reuse all previous 48 original queries in each unused temporal frame, union with five projected centre/cross range/azimuth samples per training-born box (at most63 pixels). These queries use training geometry and supplied navigation, never unused intensity to select candidates. Compare unchanged and training-selected scene only. Unused views cannot choose the winning scene.
evidence: Retain full proposal predictions/envelopes/labels, all shared search cells/memberships and omitted modes, every complete alternative surface and original training score. Seal before unused raw evaluation and assessment scene/truth/RGB. Retain all final complete surface samples, hidden faces and unmeasured prior ground; no trimming to pass.
scope: Experimental finite-family inverse and nominal multiview support, not a calibrated association test, native factor or accepted map. Shared pose/map/material uncertainty, independent-scene usefulness and actual DVL-loss benefit remain required. No new renderer, SDK, service restart, artifact download, source PR merge or noise/admission change.
